description: What Bookkeeping AP needs before it can start: a Xero login that reaches your clients' organisations, the mailbox that receives supplier bills (Outlook, Hotmail or Gmail, any one is enough), and the people who approve bills. It reads the Inbox and picks up bills from the day it's turned on.
